text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has been chosen by the<n>URA as
Umamusume of the Year, and<n>her noble conduct
during the<n>ceremony is a testament to her
worthiness to represent her<n>generation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober also takes notice of<n>this and
becomes convinced that<n>chasing after Air Groove
will help her<n>build a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing this, I feel a strange sensation<n>gripping my
chest... but I'm not sure<n>why.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Bright fully<n>immerses herself in
intense training<n>for the spring Tenno Sho. Mejiro
Ryan is concerned by her fervency<n>and has a chat
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Through their conversation, however,<n>Mejiro Ryan
comes to understand<n>how strong Mejiro Bright's
desire to<n>live up to the Mejiro legacy is, and<n>she
decides to cheer her on.
